prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Her figure is divided into 6 diagonal bands by 5 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 18% of the way down her figure from the top, about 32% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 61% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries applied RUBY RED metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright RUBY RED sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied COPPER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright COPPER sheen filling every gap. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied BRIGHT SILVER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright BRIGHT SILVER sheen filling every gap. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries applied AMETHYST VIOLET metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright AMETHYST VIOLET sheen filling every gap. Region 5 is the diagonal band between transition zone 4 and transition zone 5: it carries applied SAPPHIRE BLUE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright SAPPHIRE BLUE sheen filling every gap. Region 6 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries applied 24K YELLOW GOLD metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright 24K YELLOW GOLD sheen filling every gap. Where two regions meet, the leaf colours interlock naturally: flakes of one reach into the other and the two colours simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
